quick_skim.title: Posterior Information Dynamics of Diffusion Models for Linear Inverse Problems
quick_skim.abstract: Diffusion models are widely used as priors for linear inverse problems, yet endpoint quality does not reveal when measurement information enters reverse denoising or how it is allocated across signal directions. We study this process through the smoothed likelihood force, the difference between exact posterior and prior scores at each noise level. For a fixed measurement, its expected squared norm gives both posterior--prior relative-entropy dissipation and reverse-path relative-entropy growth. Averaging over measurements yields an information--minimum mean-square error (I-MMSE) identity linking information gain to denoising-error reduction. Under finite second moments, the force energy and its ratio to prior-score energy decay quadratically in the noising kernel's signal coefficient at high noise. Solvable models show that conditioning removes class separation already explained by the measurement, reduces a uniform index entropy over \(n\) empirical samples from \(\log n\) to \(H(I\mid r)\), and makes assimilation depend on operator--prior alignment even for identical singular values. Experiments in models with tractable posteriors evaluate these predictions. In a separate illustration with a frozen FFHQ model, masks sharing the same spectrum yield different prior-normalized null-space trajectory statistics.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper studies when and how measurement information enters the reverse denoising of diffusion models used as priors for linear inverse problems, via a smoothed likelihood force. It establishes I-MMSE identities and quadratic decay of force energy, offering a general framework applicable to EEG source localization.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 论文研究扩散模型作为线性逆问题先验时，测量信息在反向去噪过程中的注入时机与方向分配。作者定义平滑似然力（后验与先验分数之差），并证明其范数期望对应相对熵耗散与信息-最小均方误差恒等式。理论结果表明力能量随噪声尺度呈二次衰减，为评估不同先验在逆问题中的信息效率提供了工具。该方法虽不针对EEG，但EEG源定位本质上是一类线性逆问题，因此可为脑区先验的设计与分析提供可迁移的框架。

quick_skim.title: MnemoDyn: Learning Resting State Dynamics from 40K FMRI sequences
quick_skim.abstract: We present a dynamical-systems based model for resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI), trained on a dataset of roughly 40K rs-fMRI sequences covering a wide variety of public and available-by-permission datasets. While most existing proposals use transformer backbones, we utilize multi-resolution temporal modeling of the dynamics across parcellated brain regions. We show that MnemoDyn is compute efficient and generalizes very well across diverse populations and scanning protocols. When benchmarked against current state-of-the-art transformer-based approaches, MnemoDyn consistently delivers superior reconstruction quality. Overall, we find that with such large-scale pre-training on (non-proprietary) rs-fMRI datasets, we get a highly performant model for various downstream tasks. Our results also provide evidence of the efficacy of the model on small sample size studies which has implications for neuroimaging studies at large where resting state fMRI is a commonly acquired imaging modality.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: This paper presents MnemoDyn, a dynamical-systems model for rs-fMRI that leverages multi-resolution temporal modeling across parcellated brain regions. Pre-trained on 40K sequences, it outperforms transformer-based methods in reconstruction quality and generalization, demonstrating the value of brain region structure priors that can inspire EEG priors.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 论文提出MnemoDyn，一种基于动力系统的静息态fMRI建模方法，利用脑区parcellation后的多分辨率时序建模替代transformer主干。在约4万条rs-fMRI序列上预训练后，MnemoDyn在重建质量上持续优于现有transformer方法，并具有较高的计算效率和跨群体泛化能力。该结果说明脑区结构先验对于大规模神经影像动力学建模至关重要，虽面向fMRI，但对EEG脑区先验的研究具有直接的方法启发。
